crossRefs.note: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak: not as pleasing men, but God…
“Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
“Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

translations.web: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
translations.bsb: My words are from an upright heart, and my lips speak sincerely what I know.
translations.kjv: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
translations.asv: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart; And that which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.
